description: This file defines a final class 'LoanChargeValidator' responsible for validating various conditions related to loan charges within the loan account module of the project. It includes methods to ensure that charges are added only to open, non-waived, and properly scheduled loans, and that related transactions and dates are valid.

classes.name: LoanChargeValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating loan charges against certain business rules and constraints within the loan account processing logic.

methods.name: validateLoanIsNotClosed
methods.description: Validates that the loan is not closed before allowing further charges to be added.

methods.name: validateLoanChargeIsNotWaived
methods.description: Ensures that a waived charge cannot be removed or re-added.

methods.name: validateChargeHasValidSpecifiedDateIfApplicable
methods.description: Checks that if a charge has a specified due date, it is not set before the loan disbursement date.

methods.name: validateChargeAdditionForDisbursedLoan
methods.description: Ensures charges due at disbursement are not added after the loan has been disbursed.

methods.name: validateRepaymentTypeTransactionNotBeforeAChargeRefund
methods.description: Verifies that repayment-like transactions, excluding charge refunds, are not processed before existing charge refunds.

methods.name: validateChargePaymentNotInFuture
methods.description: Prevents recording a charge payment with a future date.
